data.one_liner: Easily display paginated and infinite scrolling lists in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter library for lazily fetching and rendering paginated data. It provides an InfiniteList widget with built-in support for loading, error, and empty states, as well as automatic fetching when scrolling near the end of the list.
use_when: Building activity feeds, news feeds, or lists requiring infinite scrolling
You need built-in handling for loading states, error states, and empty states during pagination
avoid_when: You only need a static list without pagination or lazy loading
strengths: Easy to implement with an API similar to ListView.builder
Customizable loading, error, and empty builders
Supports reverse scrolling, scroll controllers, and debouncing
weaknesses: Relies on external state management to actually fetch and store the paginated data
